items.title: Ken Colyer Interview, 1959-09-21
items.q: maybe alton pennell but generally it wasn't a disappointment

ctx.x: his tour in england that came across came across a lot of adverse publicity um which i know again you don't don't agree with uh mostly from critics who you don't respect but how do you think it went over with most people george's turn in england with the audiences i think they enjoyed it mainly i mean

the band always had its wonderful moments and really got going on the several numbers in the course of their session and they really they got some wonderful receptions and the only the some of the real fans might have been a little bit disappointed because lawrence marrero wasn't with them they missed not ellen lawrence in the rhythm section and maybe alton pennell but generally it wasn't a disappointment i don't think so i think they still generated more relaxed new orleans style swing than any of us can do over…
